moments.title: European Athletics Championships Finale
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships conclude today in Birmingham after a week of thrilling competition, marking the first time the event has been held in the UK.

angles.name: Final Day Buzz
angles.copy: It's the final day of the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham! Who are you cheering for to take home gold tonight? #EuroAthletics

angles.name: UK Host City Pride
angles.copy: History made in Birmingham! The UK's first ever European Athletics Championships wraps up today. What a showcase of talent!

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In', while Madonna & Kylie Minogue make a new entry with 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: #1 Track
angles.copy: Chart Alert! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still holding strong at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In'. Is it your favourite right now?

angles.name: New Entry Buzz
angles.copy: Massive new entry on the UK Singles Chart! Madonna and Kylie Minogue team up for 'Love Sensation' straight into the Top 10. Iconic!

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle turns 68
moments.blurb: Pop icon Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, celebrates her 68th birthday tomorrow, August 17th.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the legendary Belinda Carlisle tomorrow! 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth' is still an absolute anthem. What's your favourite Belinda track?

angles.name: Go-Go's & Solo
angles.copy: Celebrating Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday tomorrow! From The Go-Go's to her incredible solo career, she's given us so many hits. Let's hear 'em!

moments.title: Robert Plant's 78th Birthday
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant will celebrate his 78th birthday on August 20, 2026.

angles.name: Rock God Birthday
angles.copy: On Thursday, the golden god of rock, Robert Plant, turns 78! What's your ultimate Led Zeppelin track to celebrate the legend?

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 78th birthday to the iconic Robert Plant this Thursday! His voice defined an era. What's your favourite era of his music?

angles.name: Local Excitement
angles.copy: The Brecon Beacons are buzzing! Green Man Festival is almost here, bringing incredible music and culture to our doorstep from Thursday. Get ready!

angles.name: Football's Back!
